status: Research and experimental design only; no model loaded or training restarted
user_direction: Continue the overall project; investigate sampled long conversation paths and challenges arriving late. The crash review is a checkpoint, not cancellation.

local_evidence.text_backbone: Qwen3-4B-Base, quantized; sources/qwen3-4b-base-mlx.json. Assistant-like behavior does not establish instruction-tuning reversion in this backbone.
local_evidence.corpus: results/corpus-v6-descriptive-audit.json: 268 distinct conversations, 1390 character turns; 177 conversations have at most four exchanges, 18 have sixteen exchanges.
local_evidence.coverage_limit: Longer examples do exist. We have not established adequate variation in challenge position, token length, or the student's own imperfect histories.
local_evidence.training_limit: run22 used a 1024-token window; longest record 840 tokens. More turns in short scripted examples do not establish robustness at materially longer token contexts.
local_evidence.speech_distinction: Moshi and Qwen are different backbones. Character gains in the text adapter do not automatically transfer to native speech.
local_evidence.crash: results/system-crash-20261009.json records the exact GPU panic; no completed actual-model staged speech update. Runtime mitigation must precede heavy experiments.

sources.finding: Zero reports 5932 conversations and 73765 character turns, with dialogue generation and subsequent reinforcement learning. Our much smaller corpus and short-history concentration are substantial departures.
sources.application: Prioritize dialogue distribution and on-policy recovery before another small hyperparameter sweep; data insufficiency remains a hypothesis, not a proved sole cause.

sources.finding: OSPD uses student-generated histories, a teacher conditioned on a fuller character profile, progressive masking and SFT retention. Its inference still has a brief profile; experiments use much larger GPU resources.
sources.application: Borrow the on-policy principle, not a claim of drop-in reproduction. Our zero-profile student is an extension. Verify teacher advantage before using teacher targets; our earlier prompted local teacher pilots failed.

sources.finding: MAIGO studies prior model mistakes contaminating later conversation and uses history-cleaned teacher supervision.
sources.application: Compare actual and reviewed histories; preserve user references and events when repairing context. Do not blindly delete all earlier assistant messages or treat this task benchmark as proof of persona quality.

sources.finding: CPO addresses ambiguity in role-playing rewards through comparative trajectory evaluation.
sources.application: Keep hard identity/lore/perception checks separate from subjective naturalness comparisons. Existing acceptance gates remain unchanged.

sources.finding: Open upstream issue contains the same completeMemory prepare-count-underflow panic signature across several Apple GPU systems.
sources.application: Do not classify our crash as ordinary OOM or assume serialized jobs eliminate the driver problem.

sources.finding: A controlled single-system report found avoiding set_wired_limit prevented reproduction; avoiding cache clearing alone did not. Different hardware, model and runtime from ours.
sources.application: Investigate unwired allocation across our scripts and mlx-lm generation helpers. Start with bounded diagnostics and persisted phase logs; no guarantee this fixes the M2 crash and no blind third-party shim execution.

sources.finding: The author's small Moshi-style experiment reports unresolved garbled speech, rather than a ready replacement checkpoint.
sources.application: Useful diagnostics include per-codebook loss, codec/delay checks and free-versus-conditioned generation. Do not pivot to from-scratch small speech training on the assumption it already works.

decision: Test drift as a function of history, challenge placement and context tokens; collect reviewed on-policy corrections and recovery continuations only after establishing a bounded runtime protocol. No accepted model or measured Monte Carlo result is claimed.
